steps.summary: Replayed stored procedure s_16cc25; observed dashboard_title=rpgr15-r2 Bench Dashboard, panel_title=rpgr15-r2 Availability.

On the rpgr15-r2 Bench Dashboard, added a new Text panel titled "rpgr15-r2 Notes" with content "Notes for run rpgr15-r2". Applied the edit and saved the dashboard (confirmed via "Dashboard saved" alert). After saving, the panel title reads "rpgr15-r2 Notes" and the displayed text content is "Notes for run rpgr15-r2".

Completed the instruction on the 'rpgr15-r2 Bench Dashboard' (UID bfx6mmmorwruob). Opened dashboard settings, added the tag 'bench' to the dashboard's tags in the General settings section, and saved the settings. Set the time range to 'Last 6 hours' via the time picker, then saved the dashboard with the 'Update default time range' checkbox ticked so the 6-hour range is persisted. Verified after saving: the tag 'bench' is listed in dashboard settings under Tags, and the top bar time picker shows 'Last 6 hours'. A subsequent save attempt showed 'No changes to save', confirming everything was already persisted.

Set the auto-refresh interval to 1m via the refresh picker (the previous attempt's click on the "1 minute" menu item had already taken effect — the picker showed "1m" and the URL carried refresh=1m). Saved the dashboard via the save dialog, ticking the "Update default refresh value" checkbox (the dialog showed "No changes to save" until the checkbox created 1 change), and confirmed the "Dashboard saved" alert. Then reloaded the dashboard URL and verified: the refresh picker shows "1m" (button "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"), the top bar time range shows "Last 6 hours", and the URL is http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfx5j0ewyyku8a/rpgr15-r2-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now.
